LanguageData.HD_Crows_ConnectDesc: Select a computer and a CROWS II emplacement on this map. Each computer controls one emplacement. A new connection replaces either building's previous connection.
LanguageData.HD_Crows_DisconnectDesc: Remove the controller from the computer and stop the connected weapon.
LanguageData.HD_Crows_NoPower: Computer and emplacement both need power
